overview: A series of visually stunning films following some of the world's most extreme individuals, who risk their lives pushing themselves to the physical and mental limits of human capability.
title: Daredevils

overview: A joyful celebration of all things handmade, following ordinary people having a go at new skills taught by inspirational teachers.
title: MAKE! Craft Britain

overview: White Boyz in the Hood is based on the idea of the interrelationship between black and white culture in modern-day United States. Many famous comedians have based their comedy routines on the different cultures of a nation. The comedians are white and play towards a mostly black audience. Today in America the urban comedy scene is thriving and white comedians are honing their skills at these types of venues. The creators of this show wanted to break down walls that exist between white and black America. In doing so this show accomplishes a great deal of laughter to subjects such as employment, drug abuse and many more issues that affect Americans.
title: White Boyz in the Hood

overview: Your Husband is Cheating on Us shines a light on this powerful world revealing the show behind the show. Over the course of the series, producer and director JD Lawrence mounts his new production of the stage play Your Husband Is Cheating On Us, implementing unorthodox creative methods with his cast. His strategies include moving everyone into a house together and injecting real-life experiences from their lives into the script. Additionally, the behind-the-scenes drama between the cast members takes matters to another level that will either make or break the show.
title: Your Husband is Cheating on Us

overview: Set in Mexico City in 1994, the series follows Alejandro Falco, a policeman with a promising future and a young family. However, his world is shattered when he is shot by a mysterious attacker in the line of duty.
title: Falco

overview: The Voice of Italy is a reality singing competition and Italian version of the international syndication "The Voice" based on the reality singing competition launched in the Netherlands.
title: The Voice of Italy

overview: Trails to Tsukiji is a show that focuses on Japanese food available at Tokyo's iconic Tsukiji Market where every kind of fresh food is gathered from around the country.
title: Trails to Tsukiji

overview: British retail is vastly-changing, and the face of Brits shopping habits has drastically changed in the last few years. After a struggle in the economy, there has been a boom in the discount retail sector. In the UK, shoppers are moving towards the pound stores, second-hand shops, and clearance sales- we are going so far as to buying in bulk to save a few pence. Bargain Fever Britain is a two part documentary series giving viewers access to the four major UK discount businesses who are managing to survive in a retail landscape where none of us want to pay the full price for products.
title: Bargain Fever Britain

overview: Why leave love for fate? I Are you the one - Sweden has 20 glow singles undergoing thorough tests and interviews before arriving at a luxury home in Thailand. In the group there is one person who is each participant's "perfect match" - but nobody knows who it is. By hanging out in the house, competing and going on a date, the participants come week by week trying to figure out which ones are perfect for each other - and maybe be dear to the coup. The question is whether they fall for the right person? If all participants succeed in their matches, they share the winning sum: one million kronor.
title: Are You the One? Sverige

overview: Direct and in-depth. Interviews exploring the minds and motivations of the leaders, visionaries, artists and entrepreneurs who are changing our world.
title: Direct Talk

overview: Do you remember when we met for the first time? Hyun Jin - a girl who finally meets her coveted guy. Hee Jin - a girl that is still in love. Ha Seul - a girl who is a childhood friend.
title: First Love Story

overview: The series shows how five ardent youths from University of the Arts face love, friendship, and the future.
title: Honey and Clover

overview: The Best Moment to Quit Your Job follows five millennial women on their quest to find themselves in the early days of their professions. Series lead actress, 26-year-old Yun Ji is a rookie designer working at a wet wipes factory who shares the frustrating reality of her work life with her friends.
title: The Best Moment to Quit Your Job

overview: An arrogant third master of a powerful family falls in love at first sight with a pretty young maiden and uses every means possible to force her hand in marriage, despite her harboring a crush on another man. In the beginning of a coerced marriage, she resents him and rejects all his advances and gestures of love, but their love story slowly develops after going through obstacles in times of war andchaos. However, things get complicated when her old flame returns and becomes her husband's assistant.
title: Siege in Fog

overview: Flowever Ever After is a web drama about the frank and realistic troubles such as the love and marriage of a couple in their mid-twenties who are living together for 7 years, and a marriageable couple in their early 30s.
title: Flower Ever After

overview: Bearing his trademark tickling stick and tattifilarious jokes, The Ken Dodd Laughter Show stars Knotty Ash's most famous son in a classic mix of madcap sketches, musical numbers and quick-fire stand-up.
title: The Ken Dodd Laughter Show

overview: Screen Two is a anthology series of one-off drama's made especially for television.
title: Screen Two

overview: Show Me the Movie! features two competing teams captained by acclaimed actor Jane Harber and comedy star Joel Creasey. Each week, host Rove McManus, Jane and Joel will be joined by a stellar cast of different actors, comedians and visiting international stars, who will do battle in a series of funny, irreverent and always entertaining rounds.
title: Show Me the Movie!

overview: After delivering a sneak peek this past May, TLC is back with the series debut of the outrageous game show Labor Games. Hosted by comedian and actress Lisa Arch, it's a race against nature as a camera crew surprises parents-to-be currently in labor, offering them the opportunity to win a nursery full of prizes before the baby is born. The season premieres Tuesday, September 15 at 8/7c with two back-to-back episodes. After the initial shock and surprise, and if they agree to play the game, a normal delivery room immediately transforms into a game show set - flashing lights, game monitor, theme music, and all. The clock is ticking as couples are faced with baby-themed trivia and challenges to try to win trips, cash, baby monitors, food, clothing, and the grand prize - a $10,000 scholarship all before the ultimate prize arrives, their newborn baby.
title: Labor Games

overview: A documentary series that profiles rising stars in various fields-inspiring people who are challenging conventional wisdom and leading the pack.
title: Rising

overview: In a two-part special for Holy Week, artist Lachlan Goudie goes on a trip of a lifetime to the Holy Land, sketching and painting the people and landscapes he sees there.
title: Painting the Holy Land with Lachlan Goudie

overview: Coverage from the River Thames as rowing crews from Oxford and Cambridge Universities race each other over four and a quarter miles from Putney to Mortlake.
title: The Boat Race

overview: Follow the emotional and inspiring journeys of six morbidly obese Kiwis on the road to healthier lives.
title: The Big Ward

overview: Five British boys who have failed their core GCSEs are given a second chance at a school like no other. Inspired by studies which suggest white working class boys do better academically in ethnically mixed classrooms, the boys take part in a study programme at the world famous Doon School in India. One of the best schools in the world, with an exam pass rate of 100%, British head teacher Matthew Raggett believes he can transform the boys' prospects in just six months, preparing them to re-sit their exams. The boys will have to shake off their old habits if they wish to survive the rigorous standards at Doon. Will they knuckle down?
title: Indian Summer School

overview: Tamara always considered her eldest daughter Dinka the main mistake in her life, because Dinka was born as a result of rape. However, the attitude towards the unloved daughter is changing for the better, when Peter, a widower with his son Sasha, appears in Tamara's life. But Peter dies in a fire. According to one version, the cause of the fire at home was Dina playing with matches. Tamara's hatred for her daughter flares up again. Years pass by. Tamara fanatically loves her younger daughter Lucy, born of Peter, and adores her stepson, Sasha, who becomes more and more like his father. Having learned that Romantic relations are established between him and Dina, Tamara does her best to separate them ...
title: НЕлюбовь

overview: Myleene Klass hosts BBQ Champ, the show which follows eight of the UK's best amateur barbecuers who will battle it out for the title "BBQ Champ", and a cash prize of £25,000. In order to win, the barbecuers will have to impress the judges - 'Man vs Food', Adam Richman and British chef Mark Blatchford. In each episode the contestants will face two challenges - one at the BBQ HQ and one on a chosen location. After both challenges are completed, one of them will be eliminated.
title: BBQ Champ

overview: The owner of a factory, Tatiana decides that on the anniversary of their marriage with Gleb, she will give him the reins of government - this will be the best gift. However, on the same day the woman finds out that in her hometown where Gleb often goes on a business trip, her husband has another woman and a little daughter. Happy plans for the future are collapsing, Tatiana decides to break all relations with her husband. But then Gleb has a heart attack ...
title: Первый раз прощается

overview: Shortly after arriving in Sydney, Australia, a brilliant heart surgeon visiting from China is drawn into a deadly game whereby he must kill a stranger or lose somebody close to him. Our hero unexpectedly finds himself at the centre of a deadly, complex game when he is delivered a box with a murderous message. As a doctor dedicated to preserving life, he refuses to play - he refuses to kill. Then those he loves most, his family, come under threat. Kidnap and murder are just the start. This is the thrilling story of a man fighting against impossible odds to bring his family to safety, using everything at his disposal to outwit his unknown opponents amidst terrible danger.
title: Chosen

overview: Nadia works as a cashier in a supermarket in a small provincial town. She lives modestly with her son, Sanka. Suddenly she has a serious heart disease - she needs a heart transplant. Nadia, taking her son and cat, goes to the capital, where she is expected in a charity fund. She meets the employee of the foundation Olga and her friend Alena. While Nadia is in the hospital, Alena takes Sanka in and takes care of him. When it turns out that the fund can not help Nadia, she transfers custody of Sanka to Alena. The boy remains in the capital, and Nadia returns to her native city to die. However, after a while the donor heart is found for Nadia and she returns to the capital. Sanka lives with Alena and misses his mom. After a successful operation, Nadia wants to regain her son, but faces Alena's resistance. She is a legal guardian, and does not intend to return the child she is attached to.
title: Соломоново решение

overview: She's the feisty Geordie lass we can't get enough of - and now she's got her very own MTV reality show. Get ready for Charlotte Crosby's brand new series - The Charlotte Show! Access all areas of Charlotte's work, life and relationships as we follow the lass on her travels to Australia, Ireland and more. We'll be getting up close and personal with her mam, her BFF and of course her three cute AF dogs. Since shooting to fame on Geordie Shore, Charlotte's gone on to become a TV presenter, fashion designer and fitness mentor. With millions of social media followers, she is papped and written about daily in the national press and has had to live out some of her most personal moments in the glare of the media spotlight. Now it's time for fans to find out what really goes on behind the scenes in Charlotte's life - warts and all. Get ready for fun, adventure and (probably) a few mortal moments along the way!
title: The Charlotte Show

overview: Park Jin Young's Party People allows the audience to freely enjoy the comfortable atmosphere with guest singers. They would make small talks on music while striking interest to draw in the audience to become part of the show. It cannot be compared to other ordinary music talk shows. Be sure to check out the utmost honest charms of the stars through Park Jin Young's Party People.
title: Park Jin Young's Party People

overview: After a couple breaks up, they realize they have six months left on their lease.
title: Til Lease Do Us Part

overview: This web-drama revolves around development team manager Gye Sook Ja, a woman in her thirties who trusts in numbers and judges the world accordingly.
title: Number Woman Gye Sook Ja

overview: Drama series following the detectives of an elite murder investigation squad in London.
title: London Kills

overview: Salty Tour is a travel variety program that emphasises on two things: good quality for the price and small luxury. For every city/country, three of the cast members are assigned as one-day tour guides and are given the same budget per person. The cast members will attempt to have the best vacation experience with a fixed price limit. The Small Luxury can only be won by the winning tour guide through the judging of the remaining cast members and invited guests for each day tour.
title: Salty Tour

overview: Amazing f(x) is a South Korean documentary reality show starring the popular South Korean girl group f(x). 'Amazing f(x)' will be the f(x)'s third reality show.
title: Amazing f(x)

overview: Property expert Egypt Sherrod takes first-time house flippers under her wing, teaching them the tricks of the trade when it comes to getting top dollar for smart renovations. Will these Flipping Virgins heed Egypt's advice and make a profit from their first flip — or will their newbie jitters get the best of them as they risk it all in the unpredictable world of home buying and selling on Flipping Virgins?
title: Flipping Virgins

overview: Bachelor in Paradise Australia follows former Bachelor and Bachelorette contestants on their second chance quest to find true love.
title: Bachelor in Paradise

overview: A naive vampire prince from Vampire planet visits Earth to see a live performance of his favorite idol contender. He remains stuck on Earth with his three trusted and loyal servants. He then decides to join the competition himself and struggles to become a global pop idol.
title: Vampire Idol

overview: I Don't Like Mondays is a game show hosted by Alan Carr. In every show, one of the studio audience will win a paid year off work! The winner of each show gets to walk away with not only a year's salary, but also an amazing prize pot of things to do with their time off.
title: I Don't Like Mondays

overview: Five couples are flown to a location in the world and they compete in various challenges. Whichever couple comes last in each of the challenges are then sent home on the next plane so in the space of 24 hours four of the five couples would not only have flown to the place in question but would have flown back home too. The winners get to stay for an all expenses paid holiday.
title: Come Fly with Me

overview: A sketch comedy series highlighting some of the up and coming new comedic talents.
title: Before the Fringe

overview: Following David Youldon and his colleagues at the African Lion & Environmental Research Trust in Zimbabwe as they run a controversial programme designed to halt the declining population of the animals. At the centre, captive lions are encouraged to develop their natural skills so they can live independently and their offspring can be released into the wild.
title: Lion Country

overview: Mel Smith and Griff Rhys Jones are reunited to present the best of ten series of Smith and Jones. Plus, updated versions of their famous head-to-head talking routines.
title: Smith and Jones Sketchbook

overview: Well-known astronomers Nigel Henbest & Heather Couper host this show, crossing time and space to discover the secrets of the planets, their past, present and future. Using their knowledge of science and astronomy, they tell us the truth about the human race's home and the other planets where perhaps others lifeforms exist.
title: The Planets

overview: Following the work of the National Missing Persons Helpline to explore the mysteries behind the thousands of people reported missing in the UK every year.
title: Runaways

overview: In this continuation of the 'Maverick' series, poker player and conman Bret Maverick moves to the town of Sweetwater, AZ, and tries to take up a normal life as a cattle breeder. However, Brett's past and the troubles of Sweetwater won't leave him alone, and he soon finds himself putting his skills to use to help out his fellow citizens.
title: Bret Maverick

overview: Loving takes place in the fictional town of Corinth, PA, centering around the lives of the wealthy Alden family. Love and betrayal, along with the struggle for power, become the focus of this long-running drama.
title: Loving

overview: Documentary series set across the UK's largest county, following frontline officers at one of the country's biggest social housing providers.
title: Housing Yorkshire: Somewhere to Call Home

overview: The story is about a set of twin baby boys who were created/cloned in the laboratory as a part of gene altering/gene therapy experiment. Because of the nature of the project, the twins were born with superior physical strength, supernatural powers and extremely high IQ. Unfortunately, the twins were separated at birth. One of the brothers, Sei, grew up to be an elite bio-chemistry scientist in America. He was assigned to a project where he has to travel to a small island in Japan to investigate an unidentified virus that is spreading on the island. By a freak of nature, he found out that he has a twin brother, Rin, whose evil, dark personality is entirely opposite of him. What is going to happen when they finally meet face to face? What are their true identities? Why were they separated at birth, what other secrets are hidden from them? Does the fast spreading virus has anything to do with the twins? Who created them? And why?
title: Yasha

overview: Blunder is an ensemble sketch show written and performed by six of the UK's brightest young comedy writers and performers: David Mitchell, Simon Farnaby, Rhys Thomas, Nina Conti, Tom Meeten and Tony Way. The series features a colourful array of cartoonish characters and oddballs, shot live before a studio audience.
title: Blunder

overview: Eight writers, with special reasons to care, journey along some of the most critical frontiers in the world.
title: Frontiers

overview: The whole of Norway knows Ari Behn. He even says that the story about himself in public is a staging. But who is the peacock, the artist and the author behind the mask? Join Ari on the journey in the difficult year after divorce, when he finally has to find his place and find out who he really is.
title: Ari og halve kongeriket

overview: 10 new expectant celebrities are ready to run a restaurant in Portør. The gang all have varying kitchen skills, but together they must both cooperate and fight against each other to find out who is the best.
title: Camp Kulinaris

overview: Join a sparkling Sweden far up in the north where snow and ice are everyday for both bearers and snowmen, but not as comfortable for big city residents on a temporary visit. In Frozen roads, we go out on the roads along with the heroes who turn the northern borders into dangerous areas, despite Kung Boro's hard resistance. When the wind suddenly sweeps into the sparkling fields in snowy wrecking, the roads shine glashala and the drifting snow forms piles, then they have never longed so much for the heroes of the winter roads.
title: Frusna vägar

overview: Jesper Rönndahl is leading the satire program to explain why things are as they are, and how they should be, and joking about politics and politics. The weekly program deals with the biggest domestic news, focusing on a major subject.
title: Svenska nyheter

overview: Tina Nordström invites exciting guests to Lofoten and Svalbard. Tina takes guests from everything from kayaking to surfing and roller coaster safaris. There will also be cooking in a unique environment and confidential conversation.
title: Tina i fjällen

overview: Comedy series written by and starring Greg Davies as Dan, a childish idiot whose world is on the brink of collapse.
title: Man Down

overview: In this six-episode IFC mini-series, Gunter Vogler is a sadistic hitman who gets his face shot off by a mysterious gunman. However, the police bring him back and surgically attach the face of the last cop that Gunter killed before he was shot down. Now Gunter must find out who shot him, pretend to be a policeman, and deal with a war between the two major mob bosses in the city.
title: Bullet in the Face

overview: In the new cooking program Kockakademin, ten young chef talents compete for his big dream job: a job as a chef at Johan Jureskog's award-winning restaurant AG in Stockholm. Under the leadership of Jureskog - and with guest invitations of several other star chefs - the contestants get to learn more about the cooking art and stand against each other in tough competitions. In addition, they live together during the racing season in a luxury villa just outside of Stockholm, which gives a wonderful cookie of cooking and reality.
title: Kockakademin

overview: Laila Bagge wants to get the most out of life. She wants to be a good mom, carry out all her dreams, constantly take on new projects, have fun, develop, help others, feel loved and have deep relationships. With very many balls in the air at the same time it can easily be chaos, but after all she is (almost) always in control. At the end of the day there is only one thing that is really important to her; family. We are following Laila Bagge, who dares to share his privacy more than ever before, and the son of Liam, whose life revolves around studies, martial arts, family and friends.
title: Lailaland

overview: Who manages a hundred years of hits? It is the big challenge in a singing contest where ten famous artists will compete against each other on the live stream. Every Saturday there is music from the new decades on the poster, and it is the television viewers who decide which of the artists will be allowed on - until there is one winner left.
title: Århundrets stemme

overview: In this one-of-a-kind game show, one person will take on the entire country in trying to become the last standing champion of Alle mot 1.
title: Alle mot 1

overview: Eight artists perform in a musical multiplayer where they perform interpretations of famous hits from completely different music styles than they are used to. A panel gives them feedback and every week a participant must leave the contest, who will be up to the viewers.
title: Stjärnornas stjärna

overview: Have you ever dreamed of packing the bag to do something completely different? Øyvind Fjeldheim and Guri Solberg have traveled around the world to meet Norwegians who have followed the dream and traveled to realize it.
title: Eventyrlige nordmenn

overview: Robert Stoltenberg and Herman Flesvig's popular characters take vacation and travel in the cabin.
title: Robert og Herman

overview: Danskebåten is a docusoap showcasing the whole spectrum of life aboard Stena Saga, from the people in the engine room to the captain on the bridge, and the rest of the crew that work so that the passengers get the best trip possible. And of course, there are also meetings with many of the guests, whether they are families on a trip or regular travelers with many crossings a year.
title: Danskebåten

overview: Dynamic Asia. Stories behind the world's largest continent as it faces political, economic, cultural and technological change.
title: Asia Insight

overview: Frank Cannon isn't your typical private detective. He's overweight, likes to eat, drives expensive cars, and charges a lot of money for his services. But when you need a job done right and you don't have a big enough gun... you call Cannon.
title: Cannon

overview: With themes ranging from ancient traditions to contemporary social issues, these documentaries present intimate portraits of people's lives around Japan today.
title: Hometown Stories

overview: Inside Lens is a series by NHK World TV that broadcasts documentaries directed by filmmakers living in Asia. We air documentaries that highlight local communities as the lens through which the dynamism of modern Asia is portrayed. Inside Lens has two different formats. The first format is the documentaries about Asia directed by Asian filmmakers including foreign filmmakers who have lived in Asia for several years. There are many Asian filmmakers who have unique lens to depict the society closely and at the same time they are trying to co-produce the film with overseas broadcasters or production companies. "Unique lens" and "co-production" are the key words of the first type. The second format is the documentaries about Japan directed by foreign filmmakers living in Japan. The documentaries should be rooted in the present tense that tell relevant and timely stories about what Japan is facing today. We encourage innovative and intelligent filmmaking that speaks of the concerns of Asia and Japan today. Inside Lens is for ambitious, emerging filmmakers willing to develop projects to engage with NHK World's worldwide audiences that have interest in Asia and Japan. Strong narratives and captivating characters are essential prerequisites.
title: Inside Lens

overview: Science for our future. Cutting edge research, innovation and technology being created by Japanese scientists and engineers.
title: Science View

overview: Face to Face is a monthly talk show with the people making a difference in Japanese society today. The show's host is Robert Campbell, who is an expert in Japanese literature and culture.
title: Face to Face

overview: Sumo is without a doubt, one of the most Japanese of sports, boasting a history of more than 1500 years. We bring you daily highlights from the Grand Sumo Tournament held 6 times a year. See how powerful wrestlers with an average weight of more than 160 kilos clash in the sacred ring in a bid to claim the Emperor's Cup. Also don't miss "Sumopedia", our short introductions to sumo's profound history and fascinating trivia that airs every day after the highlight show.
title: Sumopedia

overview: Förlåt mig is an emotional reality series where regrettable people will do some of the hardest things available - ask for forgiveness. It's about loved ones, family members or close friends as they hurt and lost contact.
title: Förlåt mig

overview: J-MELO is the only Japanese music show in English. It's packed with hits, exclusive performances and interviews, and lots more on every imaginable kind of Japanese music.
title: J-MELO

overview: The forthcoming Tokyo 2020 Olympic now induces the flowering of the international exchange among Japanese society. In order to broadcast the various positive effects in each location, the research groups of the kids are assembled by this program. Kids meet the world through creating their unique video reports.
title: Kids Meet the World

overview: At Seventeen, we were all newbies at love. These are innocent and reckless high school love stories that we dare not think of doing now.
title: Seventeen

overview: There's a sound somewhere in the darkness. Lights flicker across the campsite. Your hands shake, palms sweating. You make your move, hold your breath, and hope that the jenga tower doesn't fall over. Welcome to the horror RPG, Dread.
title: Sagas of Sundry

overview: Darknet offers snippets of people's lives being interrupted by vivid instances of unexpected violence or shocking strangeness. Viewers become part of the Darknet, a mysterious closed network of disturbing imagery and stories that exist just under the surface of our ordered and safe society.
title: Darknet

overview: Sandee is an university student who is often surrounded with male friends and considered to be their buddy. One morning, she wakes up only to find herself naked in Thada's bed, who is one of her friends. Confused and shocked, they cannot remember whether they did anything during the night because they were both drunk. Now they are trying to hide this from their other friends because they do not want to destroy their friendship. However, it seems that you cannot hide falling in love forever...
title: Kiss: The Series

overview: A teen romantic comedy that tells the story of a chef named Sung Jun who is the best at his craft and has no flaws in the eyes of others, but he is simply hopeless when it comes to love. But when he meets a girl who eats everything deliciously, he falls in love at first sight.
title: Delicious Love

overview: Ten years ago, Spike, abandoned Amy and ran off to Paris with his mistress. Amy never quite recovered from the shock and has spent all that time in therapy trying to come to terms with Spike's betrayal. Amy thinks she has recovered when her lover falls in love with and moves in with her own daughter and she finds herself back at square one, alone and miserable, with only the young, beautiful, popular, cynical Tanya to comfort her. Completely out of the blue Amy and Spike literally crash into one another again in a car wash. Is there still a spark left burning between them or will past hurt and pain prevent them from reuniting?
title: Unfinished Business

overview: James Acaster: Repertoire comprises four live stand-up shows that all exist in the same universe and follow the same running narrative, coming together to form a serialised stand-up mini-series.
title: James Acaster: Repertoire

overview: When Garry Shandling passed away in 2016, he was widely remembered as a top stand-up comic and the star of two of the most innovative sitcoms in TV history. But to those who knew him, the "real" Garry Shandling was a far more complex person. Now, Judd Apatow has created a remarkable portrait of this iconic comedian in the four-and-a-half-hour documentary The Zen Diaries of Garry Shandling. Epic in scope and intimate in detail, The Zen Diaries of Garry Shandling features conversations with more than 40 of Shandling's family and friends, including James L. Brooks, Jim Carrey, Sacha Baron Cohen, David Coulier, Jon Favreau, Jay Leno, Kevin Nealon, Conan O'Brien, Bob Saget, Jerry Seinfeld and Sarah Silverman, and four decades' worth of TV appearances, along with personal journals, private letters and candid home audio and video footage that reveal his brilliant mind and restless soul.
title: The Zen Diaries of Garry Shandling

overview: Now Apocalypse is a a surreal, coming-of-age comedy that follows Ulysses and his friends Carly, Ford and Severine, who are on various quests pursuing love, sex and fame in Los Angeles. Between sexual and romantic dating app adventures, Ulysses grows increasingly troubled as foreboding premonitory dreams make him wonder if some kind of dark and monstrous conspiracy going on, or is he just smoking too much weed?
title: Now Apocalypse

overview: Far from the modern society, a number of celebrities are challenged to live as farmers did in the 19th century. In addition to living as in the past, it is a tough competition with tactics and rack games. Program leader is Paolo Roberto.
title: Farmen VIP

overview: In TV4's new documentary series Stockholm Police, viewers can follow the police's work in Sweden's capital close up. How does one day or night look at work for the police who make a difference in our streets during each workout?
title: Stockholmspolisen

overview: Solveig Kloppen invites three famous people to whom she is curious and fascinated by the home for a nice evening in the train Hageby.
title: En Kveld Hos Kloppen

overview: Britain: As Seen on ITV is a programme developed to celebrate the 60th anniversary of ITV. The show tells the story of the changing nation through the real-life footage seen on our screens over the last six decades. Exploring our changing attitudes to fashion, food, pop music, the weather, our homes and our hobbies. The series will use rare and unseen footage to be able to create a picture of how much our lives have undergone a transformation since ITV first hit our screens in 1955.
title: Britain: As Seen on ITV

overview: The real couple Björn Ferry and Heidi Andersson want to live a completely fossil-free life, and want to bring their entire home town - Storuman - on the train.
title: Storuman Forever

overview: Here we can join when people with will, strength and courage take on the challenges of their lives to make a change in their lives. What takes a whole year for the participants, we can see from start to finish in just a few minutes. Program leader is Pernilla Månsson Colt.
title: Idag om ett år
